name: Codex (OpenAI)
description: OpenAI's Codex in the AI Chat. With the Codex CLI (your ChatGPT plan) it reads the folder and proposes edits you review as a diff (with the MCP Server mod). Or with the OpenAI API and an API key kept in your Keychain — no CLI needed.
author: AICode

mode.description: cli: the Codex CLI, signed in with your ChatGPT plan. api: the OpenAI API with your API key (set the key with the Configure command, or the chat's agent picker).
